Tomato_Early_blight.organic_treatment: Apply copper-based fungicides or Bacillus subtilis early in the season.
Tomato_Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Use chlorothalonil or mancozeb as directed.
Tomato_Early_blight.preventive_measures: Rotate crops, ensure adequate spacing for airflow, and avoid overhead watering.
Tomato_Early_blight.seasonal_tips: Clear plant debris after harvest to prevent spores from overwintering.

Potato_Late_blight.organic_treatment: Apply copper sprays proactively before wet weather.
Potato_Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Use fungicides containing metalaxyl or chlorothalonil at first sign of disease.
Potato_Late_blight.preventive_measures: Use certified disease-free seed tubers and eliminate volunteer potatoes.
Potato_Late_blight.seasonal_tips: Monitor humidity; late blight thrives in cool, wet conditions.

Apple_scab.organic_treatment: Use sulfur or neem oil sprays preventatively.
Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Apply myclobutanil or captan during the green tip stage.
Apple_scab.preventive_measures: Rake and destroy fallen leaves in autumn to reduce overwintering spores.
Apple_scab.seasonal_tips: Prune trees to improve air circulation and sunlight penetration.

Healthy_Leaf.seasonal_tips: Regularly monitor for pests and maintain soil health.
